notes.title: GAT RAT Now Released!
notes.notes: [p]GAT RAT is out now! If you feel anything in the game is unfair or not strong enough, post them under the balance thread in the community hub.[/p]

notes.title: GAT RAT Demo 1.03
notes.notes:
Partial controller support, works in game. However, navigating the UI still requires a mouse.

Slightly reduced downward acceleration on player character's jump for more forgiving platforming

Added gun upgrades to the demo's available guns. Purchase upgrades at the dealer!

notes.title: Partial Controller Support
notes.notes: Gameplay for controllers is now available. However, the UI still requires a mouse to navigate. We are working on full controller support.

notes.title: Demo version 1.02
notes.notes: Spanish and Russian localization options now available for GAT RAT demo!

notes.title: Demo version 1.01
notes.notes:
Hotfixed buggy hitbox while patrolling for certain enemies

Fixed a bug where you can leave the map on route 42

Added visible version number in main menu

Added a wishlist button in main lobby for convenience

Fixed desktop icon

notes.title: Free DEMO Out Now!
notes.notes:
The GAT RAT free demo is now out, give it a try! 

The demo contains 6 levels across 4 realms. Use 7 different GATS and 4 different upgradeable spells to demolish your enemies!

notes.title: GAT RAT Store Page Now Live!
notes.notes:
A rat with a massive arsenal of guns and weapons. Cook up your favorite combination of gats, spells, and perks to casually annihilate your enemies throughout the realms.

A demo will be available for the June Next Fest, wishlist GAT RAT to be notified!
